purpose: Whole-page lead-capture form: a heading, one or two intro lines and a single centred column of labelled fields ending in a wide submit button. Used for demo booking, startup-programme applications and partner enquiries.

variants.name: get-started
variants.description: Demo booking: controlled inputs with inline validation errors (shown after the first submit attempt, then on change), a conditional extra question when the customer type is consumers, a phone field with a +1 prefix, and a scheduler dialog that opens after a valid submit.

variants.name: startups-apply
variants.description: Startup application: native browser constraint validation, adds team size and a 22-option VC firm select, hidden honeypot field.

variants.name: partners
variants.description: Partner enquiry: two intro paragraphs, two field groups with sub-headings, checkbox fieldsets (customer segment, interest), a textarea, native validation and a hidden honeypot field.

heading.note: Rendered as h1 in display-xl bold. Observed 3 to 8 words.

intro.note: One line on get-started and startups-apply (11 and 14 words), two paragraphs on partners (18 and 23 words).

fields.note: Field names observed: get-started has first and last name, company, work email, optional phone, people-count select, customer-type select, optional conditional sales-process select, optional how-heard; startups-apply adds team size (number) and firm (select); partners has full name, email, job title, company, website, partner-type select, two checkbox groups and a description textarea.

sectionHeadings.note: Partners only: sub-headings above the two field groups.

submitLabel.note: Primary button, full width, fixed 338px from lg, with a chevron.

consentNote.note: Small muted SMS-consent paragraph with links to the privacy notice and terms; get-started and startups-apply only, both rendering the shared PhoneConsent component. Observed about 43 words.

schedulerFrame.note: Get-started only: the dialog body that holds the scheduling iframe. The clone shows a fixed-height empty frame with a text placeholder and never loads or sends anything; a generator must not reproduce the live scheduler endpoint.

behaviour.note: Forms never submit. Startups-apply and partners run native constraint validation, then the submit handler calls preventDefault and does nothing. Get-started validates in JS, and on success only reveals the scheduler dialog shell; no request is ever made. No success or error state is sent or received.
Honeypot: startups-apply and partners include a visually hidden 'website' input; get-started has the same hidden field and silently drops the submit if it is filled.

Scheduler dialog (get-started): the shared static CardDialog from dialog.jsx (SchedulerShell): fixed full-screen overlay (black at 50%), centred panel with a close button, Escape and overlay click close it, body scroll locked while open (useModal). It appears and disappears with no transition.
Hero-less page: the h1 is the first content under the navbar; the whole page is this one section and no CTA band follows.
The get-started page may receive a prefilled work email from the pricing page through router state.

motion.reducedMotionNote: No animation on the page. The scheduler dialog is static (no Presence), so it does not use the dialog-overlay pattern; only the close-button opacity hover (70% to 100%) and button hover transition exist.

changes.change: section vertical padding 64 / 96 (md) / 128 (lg); the form column is capped at max-w-lg and centred at every width
startups-apply team size and firm fields sit side by side (1:2 flex); below sm they stack
submit button is 338px wide (full width below lg)
scheduler dialog frame height 440 / 520 (md) / 609 (lg) px; dialog width caps at 1060 (lg) / 1100 (xl) px
